sourceFile: 26. BRS-201506 Report checking and test  sample VP damage date 5.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups checkpoints and parameter data as the main changed factor.
issues: Primary changed factor is ambiguous; process steps are treated as changed conditions.
Baseline/test framing for VP damage before/after function checks is not established.
Sheet1 AWF settings may be unrelated or subgroup context, not proven outcome evidence.
Measurement outcomes appear header-derived and not supported by value-row citations.
Process defect sections may be separate checks and should not be merged blindly.
requiredUserQuestions: Is Sheet1 part of this VP damage validation report or a separate AWF settings note?
Should the main comparison be OK sample before vs after making VP damage?
correctionPlan: Redefine the changed factor from report context, likely VP damage creation/recheck, not process-step names.
Separate process checkpoint defect results from before/after function or vision checks.
Remove Sheet1 outcomes unless source context proves they belong to this validation.
Cite actual data rows for every extracted metric, not only header rows.
Keep judgement not_judged until baseline and test conditions are explicit.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient for final evidence because grouping and value-row support are weak.
